checks.title: No serious or critical WCAG 2.2 AA issues, light theme
checks.how: axe-core (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa) on every primary page, signed out, as the shopper and as the shop. It includes colour contrast and a name for every button, link and form control.
checks.detail: 25 pages, no serious or critical issue.

checks.title: No serious or critical WCAG 2.2 AA issues, dark theme
checks.how: axe-core (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa) on every primary page, signed out, as the shopper and as the shop. It includes colour contrast and a name for every button, link and form control.
checks.detail: 25 pages, no serious or critical issue.

checks.title: Reflow at 320 px wide and at 200% text
checks.how: Each page is measured for sideways scroll (page width minus window width) at 320 by 760, then at 1280 wide with the root text size at 200%.
checks.detail: 8 pages, no sideways scroll either way.

checks.title: Reduced motion
checks.how: With prefers-reduced-motion set, count the elements still running a repeating animation on the landing page.

checks.title: Keyboard only: plan, quote and pay
checks.how: Only Tab and Enter, from a typed request to a paid order on the demo's saved sandbox wallet. The payment result must be announced in the page's one live region.
checks.detail: made a plan (shown after 0.3 s), got the quote, paid, and the live region said "Paid from the demo's saved sandbox wallet. PayPal capture 20A395083P999284X confirmed.".

not_tested: A VoiceOver or NVDA pass by a person: only automated checks and a scripted keyboard pass ran.
The phone app (Expo) on a real device: it was checked as a web build only.
Windows high-contrast mode and forced colours.
